comment: Declared exceptions to canonical control identifiers. An entry records a known problem at source; it never rewrites a value. Remove an entry when the source catalog is corrected.

_malformed_shape.raw: the identifier exactly as the source spells it

_collisions_shape.identity: canonical control number plus its statement letter, e.g. AC-01a -- NOT the control number alone, since a control and its own lettered items share one
